record.label: Per-channel transport-energy coherence CV
record.summary: The verified fourfold full-688 per-channel transport-energy result is finite at OOF final MSE 3.2334958229470984e-8, 1.92456% better than P2R0F2D and the best autonomous capacity result so far. It remains 8.97271% above its frozen mean gate, and maximum per-network MSE is 3.408533352646559e-7 at rank643/mlp364. Its separate CP1792 feature pass makes exact Q24+CP1792+J cost 2,342,509,746,011 FLOPs, 143,486,490,459 above budget, so this exact OOF result is not submission-ready. Observer_selection remained sealed.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact H96 four-channel contribution-energy/coherence six-epoch form because verified OOF mean and maximum-network MSE fail both frozen gates; materially different hard-case/state successors remain open.
